topic: Day 49 — carousel — Trust is built by consistency, not by being right

slides.text: Being reliably the same person matters more than being correct.
Consistency, not victory, is the currency being measured.

caption:
Winning an argument doesn't make someone trust you more. Being reliably the same person across many situations does.

Follow for one of these a day.
